results.question: Explain compound interest like I’m new to it, abeg

reply.text: Omo, think about compound interest like planting money magic tree! 🌳💰 First, you put your money down (the principal). Then, e start to grow fruit (interest). But here is the sweet part: next year, your money plus the fruit you grow go start to work together to make *even more* fruit! E dey build on top of itself like snowball rolling down hill. So instead of just earning interest on your original cash, you dey earn interest on top of interest too. Omo, time na your best friend here o!

results.question: Make that explanation shorter and funnier 😂

reply.text: Compound interest na when your money start to born pickin, then those pickin start to born their own pickin too! 😂 Omo, na money wey dey get grandchildren. Just leave am to dey cook, time go make am massive!
